# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This corpus is a large bundle of concatenated call snippets, but only a modest fraction are genuine **sales/enquiry calls**. The majority of the material is internal/operational chatter: Diwali-gift distribution logistics, driver/vehicle/loading coordination, payment-collection follow-ups with dealers (Abdul/Rajesh/Yogesh sir network), production-floor clarifications (bend/length/color confirmations), and courier/location-finding calls. These were excluded per instructions.

The real sales calls that remain show **Crayon Roofing & Structures** operating as a Chennai (Manali / Andarkuppam check-post) based **manufacturer-dealer of metal roofing sheets and accessories**, plus a secondary line in **screws/fasteners** and some **polycarbonate/PUFF panel** enquiries. Call volume on pure "new customer rate enquiry" calls is reasonably good (30–40+), but deep multi-turn negotiation calls are few — most are quick rate-check/quantity calls. Given the noise-to-signal ratio, this KB should be read as a **directional, not exhaustive**, training guide.

## Products & brand ladder
Based only on what was actually quoted/discussed:

**1. Metal Roofing Sheets (core product)**
- Brands/variants mentioned: **JSW Color On Plus** (flagship, most quoted), **JSW Radiance**, **JSW Pragathi / Pragathi Color On Plus**, **Asian / Asian Indira Dhanush**, **Asian Force**.
- Thicknesses offered: 0.45 mm, 0.47 mm (most common/"ready stock"), 0.50 mm, 0.60 mm. 0.70mm explicitly **not in stock** ("0.7 mm thickness இருக்கா... இல்ல Sir, 0.6 mm-ல sky blue available").
- Colors: Sky Blue (most requested), Off White, Royal Blue, Half White, Dark Green ("Kali Shelt Green"), Grey.
- Sold both as **cut sheets (by length/feet)** and as **coil (by kg/running meter)**.

**2. Accessories (fabricated to order from sheet)**
- **L-flash**, **Ridges**, **Gutters**, **Cutters** (corner flashing) — all quoted on **standard width 610 mm / ~16 mm variants**; going beyond standard width (e.g., 900mm total across 3 sides) **doubles the rate** because it uses a full sheet instead of a strip.
- **Crimping (crimp)** add-ons for sheets.

**3. PUFF / Sandwich Panels & Wall Cladding**
- Separate factory line (not the Manali metal-sheet unit) for **PUFF panels** (wall + roof), thickness 50 mm / 40 mm / 30 mm, priced per square meter (~₹1650+GST per sq.m mentioned for 50mm puff).

**4. Polycarbonate / UPVC**
- **Lexan polycarbonate sheets**: 1.5 mm, 1.8 mm, 2 mm thickness stocked; **10 mm clear polycarbonate also sold** (₹61+tax/sq.ft mentioned once in a different context — verify before quoting). Standard max length **15 feet** for transparent/polycarbonate — cannot exceed.
- **UPVC roofing sheets**: explicitly **NOT available** ("UPVC நம்மகிட்ட available இல்லை sir. Metal roofing sheet தான் இருக்குது").
- **FRP/"Fiberglass roofing"**: customer asked, agent treated as polycarbonate enquiry.

**5. Screws / Fasteners**
- **Tata Agri-Go self-drilling screws** — sizes 1 inch, 2 inch, M8-55mm (full thread), 2.5 inch.
- **Rust-free screws**, **SDS screws**.
- Sold in "cartons" (full carton standard order unit) and smaller "master boxes" of 200 pieces.

**6. Welding consumables**
- **Tata welding rods** and **"Rasi" brand welding rods** (competing/cheaper brand) sold to dealers with scheme-based volume discounts.

**7. Not stocked / referred elsewhere**
- **Liner sheets** — repeatedly said "நம்ம இதுல பண்ணவே இல்லையே" (we don't make it); staff were asked to check with Arumuga Steel / Ariyalur Steel.
- **GI sheet (80/120 GSM spangle)** — distinguished from metal roofing sheet; agents had to check availability separately, often confusing customers who used "GI sheet" loosely to mean roofing sheet.
- **MS corrugated sheet 1.2mm** — redirected to "we only make metal roofing sheet."
- **JSW Structural channels (125x65 MS channel)** — redirected to a colleague's number for structural steel enquiries.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- JSW Color On Plus (0.47mm): **₹420 + GST per square meter** (one call), also **₹445 + GST per sq.m** (different call/date) — rates clearly fluctuate call to call, confirm live before quoting.
- JSW Pragathi Color On Plus 0.47: **₹445 + GST/sq.m**; later **₹410 + GST/sq.m** (Asian Pragathi context) — again, volatile.
- Asian Indira Dhanush (0.45 sky blue): **₹370+GST/sq.m**; another mention **₹435/sq.m**, "₹5 கம்மி பண்ணி கேளுங்க" (ask for ₹5 discount) culture is common.
- A 10ft cut sheet example: **₹1466 + 18% GST per sheet** (JSW 0.47) vs a lower-quality **Asian Indira Dhanush 0.45mm, ₹1251 + 18% GST per 10ft sheet** — used to contrast "bazaar/old sheet" customers against factory-fresh stock ("எங்ககிட்ட எல்லாமே புது sheets-தான். Old sheets கிடையாது").
- Cutter/L-flash standard rate: **₹655 per piece** at standard 610mm (300x300x3-side); confirmed correction after customer gave wrong total width.
- PUFF 50mm wall/roof: **~₹1650 + 18% GST per sq.m** (works out to ~₹2000/running meter incl. GST for standard width).
- Polycarbonate 10mm clear: "₹800 + GST per square meter" quoted once for 12ft FRP-type clear sheet.
- Screws:
  - Tata Agri 1 inch full-thread: **₹2.93 + tax** (carton rate) / full carton ≈ ₹2500.
  - Tata Agri 2 inch: **₹4.44 + tax** (carton) and **₹4.66 + tax** (rust-free variant).
  - M8-55mm self-drilling (project/sample order): no fixed rate quoted in this call, but min order discussed was 250 nos.
  - 2.5 inch full thread screw: **₹5.95 + 18% GST per small box (200 pcs)**.
- Welding rods: Tata consumer price ~**₹330–356 incl tax per packet**; competing "Rasi" brand ~**₹300/packet** (used by customer as leverage: "Rasi rate கம்மியா இருக்கு").
- **Payment terms (stated explicitly in a site/B2C deal):** "50% advance payment, balance 50% வந்து delivery-க்கு முன்னாடி payment பண்ணனும்." Vehicle/transport is **customer's scope** ("vehicle உங்க scope தான் வரும்").
- Out-of-state/out-of-city delivery is discouraged due to transport cost: "ரொம்ப long distance-ஆ இருக்கும்... உங்க local-லயே நீங்க check பண்ணி பார்க்கலாம்."
- GST is **non-negotiable / no cash-without-bill**: "without GST பண்ண முடியாது. Sir, with GST தான் full-ஆவே."

## Objection Playbook
1. **"Rate adhigama irukku" (price too high vs competitor/old rate)**
   - Response pattern: acknowledge raw material cost increase (e.g., "6% ஏறி இருக்கு"), offer small ad-hoc discount (₹5/sq.m) rather than matching old rate, and tie bigger discounts to **volume commitment** ("600 carton எடுக்கிற மாதிரி இருந்தா... discount கொடுக்கலாம்").
2. **"Enna rate retail-ல vikanum?" (dealer asking MRP/resale guidance)**
   - Reps give dealer cost price and let the dealer set their own margin: "அது நீங்க வித்துக்கலாம்... இங்க விற்கிறதுதான்." For consumer-facing situations, they explicitly separate **dealer price vs consumer price** and warn not to under-quote ("consumer price போடுங்க").
3. **"Liner sheet / UPVC / GI sheet தேவை" (product not manufactured)**
   - Honest redirection without over-promising: tell the customer plainly it's not made here, suggest where else to check (Arumuga Steel, Ariyalur production) rather than losing credibility by guessing.
4. **Transport/distance objection (out-of-district or long-distance delivery)**
   - Rather than quoting inflated freight, reps advise the customer to source locally: "Plus transportation scope உங்களது. ரொம்ப அதிகமா charges எடுத்துக்கும். So உங்க local-லயே நீங்க check பண்ணி பார்க்கலாம் sir."
5. **Custom size / non-standard cutter width pushback**
   - Reps explain the technical reason rate doubles (full sheet usage beyond 610mm standard) rather than just refusing, and immediately re-quote once correct diagram/size is confirmed.
6. **Stock-out / sample & small-quantity requests (e.g., polycarbonate 4mm, small puff panel orders)**
   - Clear boundary-setting: "quantity அதிகமா இருந்தாதான் நம்ம இது பண்ணி கொடுப்போம்... இதுக்காக நம்ம ready பண்ண முடியாது." They don't apologize excessively — they state the manufacturing economics plainly.
7. **Delivery timeline pressure ("Monday/Tuesday வேணும், urgent")**
   - Reps commit to realistic production windows (coil incoming 4-5 days, 1 week), avoid false promises, and proactively flag holidays/production off-days (e.g., Monday leave for Diwali) rather than over-committing.
